breakdown.reason: The Agent failed to resolve the inconsistency. It repeated the user's incorrect formula `NPSHa = -hs - hL - Pv/(rho g)`, which neglects atmospheric pressure. The ground truth correctly includes the atmospheric pressure term `(p_atm/(rho g))` in the formula for an open reservoir.
